notes.title: Lost Existence is going free to play.
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone,

Coming January 2021, Lost Existence will transitioning to full release and going free to play.

The team has concluded we are no longer able to work on the game, for a few reasons. For one, the lead developer has taken on a career change. Secondly, the custom engine is too time-consuming to continue development with a new lead. And, also importantly, we have struggled to get eyes on the game, since we didn't make a marketing plan in advance.

There will be no game update along with the release, and no further updates planned. You are still welcome to use the Discord and play the game for free.

Thank you for joining us on this journey :)

notes.title: Lost Existence 2.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've fixed a few things from 2.0! More to come soon!

notes.title: Lost Existence 2.0.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We're back with another massive update!

We've heard your feedback on needing more to do in the world, so that's what we've focused on for this patch. Our priority has been in improving the overall variety and immersion of the current landscape. We felt like there was too much space between interesting structures and things to explore, so we've added tons of new things to check out.

We've also gotten feedback about the game being too dark, so we've not only brightened night-time, but also, completely reworked the appearance of caves.

Thank you for your patience, we hope you enjoy the new content!

Key Features:
- Added 64 new ruins, spanning across different biome types! Each ruin contains its treasure, and has four rotated variations. The overall spawn rate has been increased.
- Reworked cave generation, adding 9 new cave plants with 4 variations each.
- Primordial foliage generation has been reworked, and ruins have been added.
- (You will need to start a new world to encounter new terrain and ruins, as they won't over-write existing area data.)
- Gem trading and upgrade costs have been completely reworked. Monster scaling has been rebalanced around it. Doubled the drop rate of Legendary gems.
- Extended the reach of block building from 6 to 7, and extended it further from 7 to 15 if you are in Creative mode.
- Added the block "Carved Sandstone".

Updates:
- Massively reduced startup times for single-player/servers.
- Added new music for 'indoor' contexts.
- Added momentum-based whoosh sound effects for falling and Crushing Leap.
- Added some randomization to tall grass, making it look more natural.
- Blocks can now be built while moving, in creative mode only.
- Made significant improvements to the cave cliffs biome.
- Further reduced the spawn rate of stalactites to improve performance.

Balance Updates:
- Reduced the ratio on Order Brings Peace (Piety grandmastery, 45) from 15% to 10%.
- Vitality Drain (Purifier fusion, 30) has been reduced from 4% of max health to 3%.
- Sins of the Titans (Piety mastery, 15) has been reduced from 3% health to 2%.

Minor Updates:
- Barrels now give/cost 30 build cores. Buckets, Stools, and Tables give/cost 10. (Was 1 for all.)
- Reduced the build gems dropped by mushrooms from 10 to 5, and reduced the build gems dropped by crystals from 40 to 15. (This is to compensate for the increased spawn rates).
- Mana and cooldown warnings now display the name of the spell that was unable to cast.
- You now put away your weapons when casting wisdom spells in creative mode.
- Creative mode no longer uses advanced spellcasting (since it needed cast times to work).
- Gem exchange ratios are no longer customizable.
- Updated the tooltip on Wind Strikes.
- Mastery help is now shown later in the game.
- Treasure now automatically faces away from walls.
- Lamps now prefer to attach to the floor, if one is available.
- Increased the number of monsters spawned into new games.
- Renamed "Custom/Multiplayer" on the main menu to "Online Multiplayer".
- Updated the connection help line.
- Increased the amount of time disappearing blocks stay onscreen after being collected.
- Changed the appearance of the development watermark, and made it appear when the HUD is disabled for screenshotting.
- Slightly decreased the size of the build reticle.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a serious movement exploit/bug.
- Fixed some transparency issues with glass.
- Fixed a bug where block variants (including lamps) would use the wrong variant for building/destroying occasionally.
- Fixed bug where no Advanced Game Options would work from the New Game menu.
- Fixed bug where Eruption of Rage was giving full Adrenaline Burst effect.
- Fixed a bug where Wind Strikes projectile reflection was not visually apparent.
- Fixed a bug where Wind Strikes projectile reflection triggered Adrenaline Burst.
- Fixed a bug where monsters could retreat from players when Monster Apocalypse mode was on.
- Fixed a bug where the upgrade tutorial could be hidden in a weird way.
- Fixed a bug where crystals could temporarily vanish.
- Fixed a bug where 3D block shadows would draw too far from their location.
- Fixed a bug where the old build tool selection menu would open when escape was pressed with a field selected.
- Fixed a bug where returning from the keybinds menu after clicking change keys on the hotbar menu, would go to the options menu, rather than the intended hotbar menu.
- Fixed a bug where clings and climbs would not disappear when switching to creative mode.
- Fixed an issue where steam invite IP addresses would erase.
- Fixed a bug where players would occasionally spawn inside of blocks on a new world.
- Fixed a bug where areas with a lot of desert and a little ice would prioritize winter music.
- Fixed a bug where ladders could occasionally float out of alignment of other ladders when an attachment block was missing.
- Fixed a minor bug where build command selection was jittery in distant locations.

notes.title: Lost Existence Beta 1.4.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We've been truly blown away by the response from our quickly growing community. Your feedback has been instrumental to developing this patch, and we couldn't have done it without you. Thank you to everyone, from the team here at Lurid Spectre Games!

[h2]Key Features:[/h2]
- Pyromancy and Piety combat controls have been improved. They now control similar to Fury, using light/medium/special attack controls with the mouse. You can use the old system by setting "Single-Spell Wisdom Clicks:ON" in Options.
- Doubled the speed of 'Collect' for breaking blocks. (This changed a default server setting, so it won't affect existing worlds, please update them manually).
- Blocks can now be built twice as fast.
- Tripled the number of natural light sources spawning in caves. (Won't affect already saved worlds).
- Greatly improved the appearance of water. It is also selectable now. (Water physics have not been added.)

[h2]Balance Updates:[/h2]
- Halved the casting time and damage of Judgement, making it serve better as a light attack. Reduced its mana cost from 150 to 50. Also increased its PvP ratio from 50% to 75%.
- Focused Sunlight (level 5 purifier fusion) has been reworked: "Judgement deals 300% more damage, costs 250% more mana, casts 250% slower, and slows your movement."
- Reduced Sins of the Titans (level 15 Piety mastery) from 4% to 3% of the target's health.
- Eye of the Storm (Level 45 Piety Grandmastery) has been reworked: "Grace of the Wind casts 50% faster, and costs 20% less mana. It also allows full movement speed." (old: 150% speed/60% less mana/-50% power)
- Reduced the mana cost of Serenity from 100 to 80.
- Pyromancy spells now give full loot from destroying blocks, rather than half.
- Reduced the horizontal distance covered by Hunter's charged leap by about 50%.
- Massively reduced the distance covered by Hunter's automatic dodge.
- Spell config files no longer use flat mana cost or cast time. They now load multipliers. This is to allow future balance changes without erasing custom world settings.

[h2]Other Updates:[/h2]
- Made overworld night brighter. This should greatly improve gameplay for low gamma monitors.
- Building torches and ladders with keybinds no longer switches your selected spell to build mode. This reduces combat disruption.
- Warning messages for running out of mana, or having spells on cooldown, now display in the center of the screen.
- Lowered the volume of the title music by 40%.
- Added descriptions on mouseover for the challenge modes in the new game menu.
- Added a "Rotate" button to build commands, which rotates around the horizontal axis.
- The loading screen now displays a warning when you try to start the game with insufficient memory available.
- Fixed the behavior of mouse holding while using Wisdom spells, allowing swapping between mouse buttons AFTER casting. Keyboard-holding spells has been removed.
- Block select up and down keybinds now default to arrow keys (was period and comma).
- Removed some of the tutorial boxes from mastery selection for higher level players.
- Dungeon Graveyards are now enabled by default, since they show on the build tool screen. (Will not affect existing worlds, they'll have to be updated manually).

[h2]Bugfixes:[/h2]
- Fixed a major bug where players could cast spells while flying through the air for a Crushing Leap attack.
- Fixed a bug where monsters could get severely stuck inside of blocks.
- Fixed a bug where mana checks for starting the swing of melee spells were ignoring masteries, but not costing extra.
- Cave music now plays deep in sandstone caves, based on height.
- Fixed a minor bug where allocating Rapid approach would change the channeling sound effect of Solar Fury, even when Magnetar was not active.
- Fixed a minor bug with the Strong Leap tooltip.
- Fixed a minor visual bug with torches against 3d object backgrounds.
- Fixed a minor issue where dead connections could stay active on a server, preventing that player from logging in again.
- Fixed a minor bug where, when the server owner sets a spell cost higher than 500, the mana bar extended out of its frame.
- Fixed a minor bug where build tools would be slightly inconsistent if executed while a text field was selected.
- Corrected the tooltip for Acrobatics.

notes.title: Lost Existence Beta 1.3.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lost Existence Beta 1.3.0 Patch Notes:

Updates:
- Reduced the required level for tier 1 masteries from level 10 to level 5, and tier 2 masteries from level 20 to level 15.
- Reduced the relative cost of buying legendary gems.
- Removed the massive shop tax on sell and transform gem trades. You may now trade freely between gem rarities. (Does not affect existing worlds, unless you delete data/game/trades from that save folder.)
- Made significant improvements to the visibility of the combat tutorials.
- The action helper now displays near the middle of the screen when a treasure or crystal is selected, making the key much more obvious.

Balance Updates:
- Reduced the cost of Common upgrades by 50%.
- Increased the knockback of Wild Slash by 30%. This improves combat flow significantly.
- Reduced the power of Wild Slash by 11%.
- Eruption of Rage now has reduced travel distance. (This is a buff).
- Eruption of Rage now deals 75/80/85% damage (from 90%/100%/110%). (This is a nerf).
- Reduced the knockback from Hunter's Bite by 70%.
- Increased Lost Knight knockbacks by 15%.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where Crushing Leap's healing from Adrenaline Burst was reduced by Erupting Rage.
- Fixed a bug where Erupting Rage was not scaling experience.
- Fixed a bug where double-tap dodges, when enabled, would not finish the dodge tutorial.
- Fixed a bug where combat tutorials could not be skipped by outleveling them.
- Fixed a bug where upgrade and mastery tutorials could not be done in either order.
- Fixed numerous bugs that could be abused to cancel casting of melee attacks.

notes.title: Lost Existence Beta 1.2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lost Existence Beta 1.2.0 Patch Notes:

Public Server:
- A public chaos server has been added to the multiplayer connect menu! While we cannot make any guarantees about stability or experience on this server, it's now available to do whatever you want, including meeting other players! No rules will be enforced, aside from banning cheats.

PvP Teams:
- Added a PvP team system to the game, enabled by default on all servers, supporting up to 20 team numbers from the new interface, or near-infinite from chat commands. Other players' status backgrounds will now change color based on their relation to you. Yellow is neutral, blue is allied, and red is hostile. Allies can be healed, neutral players can't be healed or damaged, and hostile players can be killed. You can change your PvP team from the top right corner of inventory, or by typing "/team (team number)". Switching has a one minute cooldown.
- When the server is in PvE mode (default): Normally, you can only heal everyone, no killing. Joining a team will allow you to kill players who have joined a different team, but will prevent you from healing or being healed by neutral players.
- When the server is in PvP mode: Normally, you can only kill other players, no healing. Joining a team will allow you to heal other players on the same team.

Updates:
- Completely reworked the appearance of the ingame tutorials.
- Added dodging, double jump, melee, spell, upgrade, and mastery tutorials.
- Changed the "out of mana" sound effect, and added a limit to how often it can play.
- Added an automatically generating 2x2 bedrock platform underneath spawn on all worlds. This is to combat spawn griefing in public servers.

Balance Updates:
- Increased overworld spawn rates by about 25%. This is largely to compensate for a previous bugfix.
- Globally reduced monster health and damage by about 10%, and reduced the amount of randomness on their hits.
- Adrenaline Burst now scales with PvP ratios on player hits, reducing it.
- Savage Impact and Crushing Leap now deal 20% less damage in PvP. (Does not affect existing worlds)
- Wild Slash now deals 50% damage in PvP (from 60%, nerf). (Does not affect existing worlds)

Minor Updates:
- Slightly increased the compass opacity.
- Mastery tabs now glow very obviously when you have unspent points on that specialization.
- Made the upgrade and mastery counters in the bottom left MUCH more obvious.
- Players now recieve 0% experience from PvP, from 10%. This can be changed in the server config file.
- The "/pvp" command now supports toggling it without adding "on/off".
- Closing the inventory screen will now set your upgrade shop page to the first page.
- Changed the compass key to "More/Less" instead of "+/-".
- You can now use "/level" as an alias of "/setlevel".

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where choosing a save file would not enable the load game button to open that save.
- Fixed a bug where players were receiving PvE stamina experience from damage dealt by other players.
- Fixed a bug where Grace of the Wind appeared too large while being charged up.
- Fixed a bug where the "Reconnect to World" button would not appear if the client has no previous single-player save file.
- Fixed a bug where experience gain would set a minimum of 1, when players would normally gain 0 experience from an action.
- Fixed a bug where rotating vertically while flying would move entity nameplates out of position until leaving flight mode.
- Fixed a bug where particle effects continued to appear on player corpses.
- Fixed another bug where players could get stuck in the void.

notes.title: Lost Existence Beta 1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lost Existence Beta 1.1.1 Patch Notes:

Updates:
- Newly created characters (or switching class) now always sets Fury as the "First Specialization", putting it on 1-3. This also changes the default mouse buttons to use Fury attacks, instead of Burning Ember, strongly affecting first impressions when people don't know how to use the hotbar.
- Added coordinates to the bottom of the screen when using build tool mouse select, indicating the location of where the mouse is pointing.
- While in Creative mode, a short list of keybinds is now visible. This can be disabled with the keybind helper option.
- Added a tooltip in the bottom right that indicates how to swap to build mode. This can be disabled with the keybind helper option.
- When in the new game menu, if you have previously played on the selected world name, it now automatically adds a number to the end, saving you a click.
- Added a build tool help file, which can be accessed from the bottom left of the build tool menu.
- Added "Dungeon Server" and "Monster Apocalypse" help files, accessible from the "Advanced Options" menu of "New Game".
- Added 'Patch Notes' and 'Discord' to the main menu.

Aesthetic Updates:
- Improved the texture for build preview models.

Minor Updates:
- Slightly improved the in-game combat tutorial.
- Removed the automatic check to watch a tutorial video on first run. It can still be viewed via the inventory screen.
- Increased the default mouse sensitivity. This won't change existing settings if you've played before.
- Leaving creative mode now sets your flight speed to at least 1.
- The setlevel command no longer requires "All" as a skill type parameter to set all levels. IE: "/setlevel 60" will now work.
- Changed the name of the "Update Preview" button to "Preview".
- "Mouse Select" is now yellow.
- The selection wheel now stays open for longer.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where "Continue Game" and "New/Load Game" would appear even on a fresh installation.
- Fixed an issue where the tutorial video had music, which clashed with the main menu.
- Fixed a bug where non-flying monsters would disappear if they were created high in the air.
- Fixed a bug where opening a help file while in fullscreen mode could possibly crash the game.
- Fixed a bug where the music context could get stuck in grasslands.
- Fixed a bug where some tutorials showed while dead.
- Fixed a bug where the crystal selection box was much too small.
- Fixed a bug where monster aggro warnings displayed while in build tool select mode.
- Fixed a bug where floating combat numbers would display while in build tool select mode.

notes.title: Lost Existence Beta 1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Lost Existence Beta 1.1.0 Patch Notes:

Thank you to our growing community for the feedback on this patch! Monumental improvements have been made to the building process, as well as many other substantial changes. Special thanks to Gravix for his feedback on this version.

Additions:
- Finished the "Class" tab. It now shows your active class, skills, masteries, and fusions, in a nice organized list.
- Added an "Advanced Options" menu to new games, making it much easier to modify the server setup, including options such as: "Loot Rate", "Monster Apocalypse", and "Monster Spawn Rate".
- Added a short built-in tutorial on how to switch classes and use different class spells. Many new players didn't figure this out. This can be restarted from options.
- Added climbable vines to the game.

Building Interface Improvements:
- Added a new way to place build tools, using the mouse cursor to select where to put it.
- Added hotbar interface for switching between build tools.
- Build tools that follow coordinates can now be moved effortlessly with WASD/Space/Shift! This adjusts according the direction you're facing for easy use.
- Added Dungeon Checkpoints to the build tools interface.
- Added a new option to some build tools, called "Keep Center on Resize", which allows them to expand from the center instead of an edge, when size is changed.
- Build previews now auto-update if already visible, instead of requiring an update preview click. The exception to this is spheres over 30 radius, due to the required rendering time.
- The build preview menu now starts with cuboid selected, rather than nothing.

Game Balance:
- Increased the spawn rate of Swarm packs by 50%, but reduced experience gain by 14%, and reduced loot by 20%.
- Reduced ambient monster spawns over time by 65%. Chunk discovery spawns are unaffected; this change only affects the hordes that were spawning when you stayed in one place too long.
- Massively increased the hitbox of friendly targets when 'wide healing' is enabled (which is default).
- Mushrooms of all types now give/cost 10 build gems (from 0).

Aesthetics:
- Made build preview models more transparent.
- Build preview models now ignore fog.
- Updated the preview for Monster Spawn Point.
- Increased the opacity of the 'Upgrade' and 'Mastery' counters in the bottom left.
- When looking directly at a chest or crystals, the interface now expands the help text with the collect keybind.
- The cooldown number for melee spells no longer show when they are locked by another effect, such as being midair for Crushing Leap.

Minor Changes:
- Build commands have been renamed to build tools clientside.
- Changed loot ratios to allow fractional values.
- Added the empty 'owner' rank to permissions.
- The "dungeon graveyard" command has been renamed to "dungeon checkpoint".
- Room commands now default "Air Fill" to ON.
- Reorganized the build tools buttons.
- Reduced the opacity of Build Tools buttons and features so the preview is more easily visible.
- The "Close" button on build tools now says "Close/Open (P)" to show that the toggling key exists.
- On build tools, the "Clear Preview" button has been renamed to "Hide Preview".
- The Instant PvP Arena button  has been made red.
- The 'Replace Only' property of build tools has been visually renamed 'Replace Specific Block'.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug where "ambient spawn rate" only supported whole numbers, despite being a fraction.
- Fixed a bug where the inventory menu could get stuck behind the build tools window when pressing 'P'.
- Fixed multiple bugs with the Monster Spawn Point interface.
- Fixed a bug where the instant pvp arena button did not work.
- Fixed a bug where the build interface would not close when 'I' was pressed.
- Fixed a bug where three commands were missing usage help when used incorrectly.
- Fixed a bug where owners were getting rank 4 instead of 3.
- Fixed a bug where setrank could create admin rank for accounts that didn't yet exist.
- Fixed a bug where dungeon checkpoints could over-write existing dungeon checkpoints with the same name.
- Fixed a bug where monster spawnpoints could over-write existing monster spawnpoints with the same name.
- Fixed a bug where players could clip into blocks while moving down on ladders.
- Fixed a bug where players would stop at the bottom of ladders while holding shift.
- Fixed some interface elements that were artifacting.
- Fixed a bug where the connect screen was shown when launching singleplayer failed.
- Fixed a bug where invalid versions attempting to connect to a newer server would not display the version error.
- Fixed a bug where build commands could be used with invalid coordinates.
- Fixed a bug where slower computers may not be able to connect to singleplayer.
